keyPoints: GeoACE 由五专家组成，各专家采用不同几何归纳偏置，融合权重在内部验证上学习并冻结后用于测试。
第五专家 O-Phi-ACE 构建无结果的低维重叠感知投影，替代锚点输入以增强稳健性。
在七个个体效应真值基准上，加入 O-Phi-ACE 降低了平均 sqrt(PEHE)，并在 1225 个配对任务中赢得 998 个。
综合排名在七个 sqrt(PEHE) 基准上平均秩最低，但 Friedman 与 Iman-Davenport 检验不显著。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers a robustness strategy for heterogeneous treatment-effect estimation that avoids relying on a single inductive bias and highlights leakage-free aggregation, with practical relevance for observational causal inference.
cards.descriptionEn: The paper proposes GeoACE, a five-expert framework for heterogeneous treatment-effect estimation that combines different geometric inductive biases with frozen aggregation weights, reporting reduced sqrt(PEHE) across several benchmarks.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on eight benchmark protocols, and some performance differences are not statistically significant. The aggregation weights and expert selection rely on internal validation, so generalizability requires independent validation. The change on JOBS policy risk was negligible, and no single weighting rule is shown to be universally superior.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为异质处理效应估计提供了一种不依赖单一归纳偏置的稳健化思路，并强调了无泄漏聚合的重要性，对观察性因果推断实践有参考价值。
cards.titleEn: Geometry-Diverse Expert Ensembles Improve Robustness of Heterogeneous Treatment-Effect Estimation
cards.summaryEn: The authors introduce GeoACE, which combines an anchor-correction estimator with complementary overlap-aware and outcome-guided geometries. Ensemble weights are learned only from internal validation predictions and frozen before test evaluation, while the fifth expert O-Phi-ACE replaces the anchor input with an outcome-free, lower-dimensional overlap-aware projection. The authors report that adding O-Phi-ACE reduced mean sqrt(PEHE) on seven benchmarks and that inverse-DR weighting was consistently better than several selection methods but statistically indistinguishable from equal weighting.
cards.summary: 作者提出 GeoACE 框架，将锚点校正估计器与重叠感知、结果引导等互补几何的专家结合。其集成权重仅基于内部验证预测学习并在测试前冻结，第五个专家 O-Phi-ACE 用无结果的重叠感知投影替换锚点输入。作者报告在七个基准上加入 O-Phi-ACE 降低平均 sqrt(PEHE)，并称逆 DR 加权优于若干选择方法但未显著优于等权。
cards.limitations: 证据来自八个基准协议，部分指标差异未通过显著性检验；集成权重与专家选择在内部验证上完成，其泛化性仍需独立数据验证；JOBS 上的政策风险变化可忽略，且未证明某一种加权规则普遍最优。
cards.title: 异质几何专家集成提升因果效应估计稳健性
keyPointsEn: GeoACE consists of five experts with different geometric inductive biases, and its ensemble weights are learned on internal validation and frozen before test evaluation.
The fifth expert, O-Phi-ACE, constructs an outcome-free lower-dimensional overlap-aware projection to replace the anchor input.
On seven benchmarks with individual-effect truth, adding O-Phi-ACE reduced mean sqrt(PEHE), winning 998 of 1,225 paired tasks.
The five-expert ensemble had the lowest average rank across the seven sqrt(PEHE) benchmarks, but omnibus Friedman and Iman-Davenport tests were not significant.
cards.description: 论文提出 GeoACE，用五种几何视角的专家模型估计异质处理效应，并通过冻结权重融合，在多个基准上降低了 sqrt(PEHE)。
cards.originalTitle: Diverse Geometries, Frozen Weights: Robust Heterogeneous Treatment-Effect Estimation via Causal Expert Ensembles

keyPoints: 提出“智能体组合泛化”假设：强化学习主要优化高层决策与技能路由，而非从零学习领域特定技能。
River 通过过滤低质量环境、以过程级行为正则增强结果奖励，强调验证器质量优先于环境数量或多样性。
在四个终端智能体基准上，River 于评估的开源强化学习 8B 模型中表现最佳，并跨模型家族、规模、智能体框架与强化学习目标泛化。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shifts the focus of terminal-agent RL from environment quantity and diversity toward reward or verifier quality and generalization mechanisms, offering a new perspective for building scalable and better-generalizing terminal-agent training recipes.
cards.descriptionEn: The paper proposes the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis, arguing that reinforcement learning does not teach terminal agents new domain-specific skills from scratch but instead shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning. Based on this, the River training recipe filters low-quality environments and augments outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. U
cards.limitationsEn: Based on the abstract, the conclusions mainly come from the evaluated terminal-agent benchmarks and model range; it is unclear whether they apply to other tasks, modalities, or real user environments. The abstract lacks full experimental settings, statistical significance, and failure cases, so the findings should not be treated as universal conclusions or investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作把终端智能体强化学习的关注点从环境数量与多样性转向奖励/验证器质量与泛化机制，为构建可扩展且泛化更好的终端智能体训练方案提供了新视角。
cards.titleEn: Reinforcement Learning Shapes Compositional Generalization Behaviors in Terminal Agents
cards.summaryEn: This paper studies how reinforcement learning improves terminal agents and proposes the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills, rather than learning domain-specific skills from scratch. The authors propose River, a training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Experiments show that River achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models on terminal-agent benchmarks and generalizes across model scales and agent harnesses.
cards.summary: 论文研究强化学习如何改进终端智能体，提出“智能体组合泛化”假设：强化学习主要塑造组合与路由低层技能的高层决策行为，而非从头学习领域特定技能。作者据此提出 River 训练配方，通过过滤低质量环境并用过程级行为正则增强结果奖励，从而提升验证器/奖励信号质量。实验显示，River 在评估的终端智能体基准上取得开源强化学习 8B 模型中的最佳表现，并跨模型规模与框架泛化。
cards.limitations: 依据摘要信息，结论主要来自所评估的终端智能体基准与模型范围，尚不清楚是否适用于其他任务、模态或真实用户环境；摘要未提供完整实验设置、统计显著性与失败案例，因此不能推断为通用结论或投资依据。
cards.title: 强化学习塑造终端智能体的组合泛化行为
keyPointsEn: Proposes the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: RL mainly optimizes high-level decision-making and skill routing rather than learning domain-specific skills from scratch.
River filters low-quality environments and augments outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization, emphasizing verifier quality over environment quantity or diversity.
On four terminal-agent benchmarks, River performs best among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models and generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives.
cards.description: 论文提出“智能体组合泛化”假设，认为强化学习不是从头教终端智能体新领域技能，而是优化其在预训练与监督微调阶段已获得低层技能之上的高层决策与路由行为。据此设计的 River 训练配方通过过滤低质量环境并对结果奖励加入过程级行为正则，在四个终端智能体基准上取得评估范围内 8B 开源强化学习模型的最佳表现，并在 2B 至 27B 模型、不同智能体框架与强化学习目标间泛化；验证器质量被认为比单纯增加环境数量或多样性更重要。
cards.originalTitle: Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents

keyPoints: 提出整合病灶、患者、人群三层证据的模块化黑色素瘤鉴别诊断框架，并支持各层级决策。
设计解剖部位感知掩码Transformer，处理患者内数量可变的多病灶及其发病部位。
通过可学习人口统计学嵌入引入患者元数据；在SIIM-ISIC 2020上报告特异度分别提升17.15%和7.14%，并改善平衡准确率。
cards.whyItMattersEn: In melanoma differential diagnosis, focusing on a single lesion may ignore patient-level multi-lesion distribution and population statistics. This framework incorporates lesion location and patient metadata as quantifiable evidence and experimentally shows their impact on specificity and balanced accuracy, offering a reproducible research path to understand tradeoffs between information types and diagnostic metrics, with code publicly available.
cards.descriptionEn: This work presents a modular, multi-level framework that integrates contextual information and evidence at the lesion, patient, and population levels for the differential diagnosis of malignant melanoma. It introduces an anatomic-site-aware masked transformer to model a variable number of lesions per patient and their sites of incidence, and incorporates patient metadata through learnable demographics embeddings. Its novelty lies in an evidence-driven exploration of how speci
cards.limitationsEn: Validation is based only on the SIIM-ISIC 2020 dataset, so generalization to other populations, institutions, or imaging protocols remains unclear; the abstract does not report disease prevalence, confidence intervals, stratified sample sizes, or external validation, so the specificity gains cannot be directly extrapolated to clinical benefit; tradeoffs across information types require more comprehensive evaluation; this is a methodological and experimental report and does not constitute clinical diagnostic or investment advice.
cards.whyItMatters: 黑色素瘤鉴别诊断中，仅看单个病灶可能忽略患者层面的多病灶分布和人群统计信息。该框架把病灶位置与患者元数据作为可量化证据纳入，并以实验展示其对特异度和平衡准确率的影响，为理解信息类型与诊断指标之间的权衡提供了可复现的研究路径，代码已公开。
cards.titleEn: Evidence-Driven Multi-Level Framework for Differential Diagnosis of Malignant Melanoma
cards.summaryEn: Facts: the authors propose a modular, multi-level framework that integrates context and evidence at the lesion, patient, and population levels for differential diagnosis of malignant melanoma; an anatomic-site-aware masked transformer models a variable number of lesions per patient and their sites, while patient metadata is incorporated via learnable demographics embeddings. They validate on the SIIM-ISIC 2020 dataset and report that including lesion location context and metadata improves specificity by 17.15% and 7.14%, respectively, while enhancing balanced accuracy. Opinion: the authors argue that this evidence-driven approach helps understand the influence of specific information on decision-making and observe tradeoffs in metrics across information types.
cards.summary: 事实：作者提出一个模块化、多层级框架，整合病灶、患者和人群层面的上下文与证据，用于恶性黑色素瘤的鉴别诊断；其中解剖部位感知掩码Transformer用于建模患者内数量可变的多病灶及其部位，患者元数据通过可学习人口统计学嵌入引入。作者在SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集上验证，报告加入病灶位置上下文和元数据分别使特异度提升17.15%和7.14%，并改善平衡准确率。观点：作者主张该证据驱动方式有助于理解特定信息对决策过程的影响，并观察到不同信息类型之间存在指标权衡。
cards.limitations: 验证仅基于SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集，结论是否可推广到其他人群、机构或影像采集协议尚不明确；原文摘要未报告疾病流行率、置信区间、样本量分层或外部验证结果，特异度提升幅度不能直接外推为临床收益；不同信息类型之间的指标权衡也需要更全面的评估；该研究为方法学与实验报告，不构成临床诊断或投资建议。
cards.title: 黑色素瘤鉴别诊断引入病灶与人群多层级证据建模框架
keyPointsEn: Proposes a modular melanoma differential diagnosis framework integrating lesion-, patient-, and population-level evidence to support decision-making at each level.
Designs an anatomic-site-aware masked transformer to handle a variable number of lesions per patient and their sites of incidence.
Introduces patient metadata via learnable demographics embeddings; reports specificity improvements of 17.15% and 7.14% on SIIM-ISIC 2020 and enhanced balanced accuracy.
cards.description: 该工作提出模块化多层级框架，将病灶、患者和人群三个层面的上下文与证据整合到黑色素瘤鉴别诊断中，并设计解剖部位感知的掩码Transformer来建模数量可变的多病灶及发病部位，同时通过学习式人口统计学嵌入引入患者元数据。其新意在于用证据驱动方式探索不同信息对决策的影响与指标权衡；在SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集验证显示，加入病灶位置上下文与元数据分别使特异度提升17.15%和7.14%，并改善平衡准确率，因而对提升恶性黑色素瘤筛查的可靠性具有参考价值。
cards.originalTitle: Evidence-Driven Differential Diagnosis of Malignant Melanoma

keyPoints: 用LLM驱动的属性匹配建立双源POI对应关系，将匹配复杂度从O(N²)降至O(N)。
位置与属性优化互为反馈构成闭环，配合样本净化与自适应半径收缩，基本两次迭代即收敛。
提出免训练LULC制图方法，通过位置融合继承加密地图的用地类别，输出矢量—栅格一体化地图。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If reproducible, the method offers a training-free route to unify encrypted vector data across coordinate systems, enabling georeferencing to WGS-84 without field-surveyed ground control points and supporting land-use/land-cover mapping with less reliance on labeled data and manual tuning.
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a training-free location-attribute synergic closed-loop optimization paradigm that fuses points of interest from two encrypted coordinate systems and derives vector-raster integrated land-use/land-cover maps, whose value lies in georeferencing encrypted vector data to WGS-84 without field-surveyed ground control points.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the paper's reference-free evaluation on 31 provincial capitals and municipalities, compared against an open-source baseline and one state-of-the-art method; other city tiers, terrains, and encryption schemes are untested, and independent replication with field control-point validation is absent. The 4.58 m residual and 95.12% accuracy are averages without reported regional variation or failure cases, and the LLM matching and fuzzy confidence steps depend on model version and prompt design, leaving stability, cost, and transferability unclear.
cards.whyItMatters: 若结果可复现，该方法为加密矢量数据的跨坐标系统一提供免训练路径，无需实地测量控制点即可完成到WGS-84的地理配准，并可支撑土地利用/覆盖制图，减少对标注数据与人工调参的依赖。
cards.titleEn: LLM-Driven Training-Free Fusion of Dual-Source Encrypted POIs for Land-Use Mapping
cards.summaryEn: The paper addresses intertwined location and attribute uncertainties in dual-source encrypted points of interest (DSEP) with a training-free, LLM-driven location-attribute synergic closed-loop paradigm. Attribute-synergic location fusion uses LLM-based attribute matching to establish correspondences and an improved particle swarm algorithm to refine transformation coefficients in ISODATA subregions; location-synergic attribute fusion then reassesses attribute confidence from geometric residuals via an LLM-fuzzy method, forming a bidirectional loop. A reference-free evaluation across 31 provincial capitals and municipalities in mainland China reports an average location fusion residual of 4.58 m and attribute fusion accuracy of 95.12%.
cards.summary: 论文针对双源加密兴趣点（DSEP）中位置与属性不确定性交织的问题，提出由大语言模型驱动的免训练位置—属性协同闭环优化范式。属性协同位置融合用LLM建立对应关系并用改进粒子群算法在ISODATA子区中精化变换系数；位置协同属性融合再借LLM模糊方法由几何残差重估属性置信度，形成双向闭环。作者在31个省会及直辖市开展无参考评估，报告平均位置融合残差4.58米、属性融合精度95.12%。
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自论文在31个省会及直辖市上的无参考评估，比较对象为开源基线与一项先进方法，未涉及其他城市等级、地形或数据加密方式，也缺少独立第三方复现与实地控制点校验；4.58米残差与95.12%精度为平均值，未给出分区域波动和失效情形；LLM匹配与模糊置信度依赖模型版本与提示设计，其稳定性、成本与可迁移性尚不明确。
cards.title: LLM驱动免训练双源加密POI融合与用地制图
keyPointsEn: LLM-driven attribute matching establishes DSEP correspondences, reducing matching complexity from O(N²) to O(N).
Location and attribute optimization feed back into each other as a closed loop, converging in essentially two iterations with sample purification and adaptive radius contraction.
A training-free LULC mapping method inherits land-use classes from encrypted maps through location fusion, producing vector-raster integrated maps.
cards.description: 提出免训练的位置—属性协同闭环优化范式，用于融合两套加密坐标系下的兴趣点，并据此生成矢量—栅格一体化土地利用/覆盖制图；其价值在于无需实地控制点即可将加密矢量数据配准到WGS-84。
cards.originalTitle: LLM-Driven Training-free Location-Attribute Synergic Fusion: A Closed-Loop Paradigm for Dual-source Encrypted POIs and LULC Mapping

keyPoints: ChartBias 是首个针对视觉语言模型图表解读社会偏见的系统审计基准，通过固定图表仅替换群体词控制变量。
在 12 个专有与开源模型上发现叙事偏移、群体幻觉和偏好极性三类普遍失败模式。
多智能体缓解框架将图表证据抽取与群体条件生成分离，并用反事实评判器验证群体差异是否有图表依据。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Vision-language models are increasingly used to generate interpretations of public data, and their narratives can shift with social group labels despite fixed charts, potentially reinforcing stereotypes or misleading decisions. The benchmark and mitigation framework bring fairness and consistency into chart understanding evaluation, offering actionable directions for auditing high-stakes applications.
cards.descriptionEn: This study introduces ChartBias, the first benchmark to systematically audit bias in vision-language model chart interpretation by fixing charts and swapping only social group terms; it identifies failure modes such as narrative shift, group hallucination, and preference polarity, and offers a multi-agent mitigation framework as a reproducible fairness baseline.
cards.limitationsEn: The study relies on the authors' ChartBias benchmark covering six social attributes and 820 real-world charts; generalization to other attributes, chart types, or languages requires caution. The multi-agent mitigation framework serves only as a baseline and is not proven to eliminate bias in all deployment settings, and updated model versions could alter results.
cards.whyItMatters: 视觉语言模型开始用于生成公共数据解读，其叙事可能随社会群体标签变化而偏离图表事实，进而强化刻板印象或误导决策。该基准与缓解框架将公平性和一致性引入图表理解评估，为审计高风险应用提供可操作方向。
cards.titleEn: Benchmarking Social Bias in Vision-Language Chart Interpretation
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents ChartBias, a benchmark of 820 real-world charts spanning race, income, age, religion, immigration status, and gender, yielding 8,638 paired generations by holding charts fixed and swapping group terms. Across 12 models and 155,484 responses, the authors observe three failure modes: narrative shift, group hallucination, and preference polarity. They argue chart understanding evaluation must measure fairness and consistency across social groups, and propose a multi-agent framework as a mitigation baseline.
cards.summary: 论文提出 ChartBias 基准，包含 820 张真实图表，覆盖种族、收入、年龄、宗教、移民身份和性别六个属性，通过固定图表仅替换群体词构建 8,638 对生成样本。在 12 个模型共 155,484 条响应中，作者观察到叙事偏移、群体幻觉和偏好极性三种失败模式。作者认为图表理解评估需同时衡量准确性与跨群体公平性，并提出多智能体框架作为缓解基线。
cards.limitations: 研究基于作者构建的 ChartBias 基准，覆盖六个社会属性和 820 张真实图表，结论外推到其他属性、图表类型或语言时需谨慎。多智能体缓解框架仅作为基线，未证明在所有部署场景中消除偏见，模型版本更新也可能改变结果。
cards.title: 视觉语言模型图表解读中的社会偏见基准
keyPointsEn: ChartBias is the first benchmark for systematically auditing social bias in vision-language chart interpretation by fixing charts and swapping only group terms.
Across 12 proprietary and open-source models, three widespread failure modes emerge: narrative shift, group hallucination, and preference polarity.
A multi-agent mitigation framework separates chart-grounded evidence extraction from group-conditioned generation and uses a counterfactual judge to verify group-driven differences.
cards.description: 该研究推出首个系统审计视觉语言模型图表解读偏见的基准 ChartBias，通过固定图表仅替换社会群体术语，发现叙事偏移、群体幻觉与偏好极性等失败模式；其多智能体缓解框架为可复现的公平性评估提供基线。
cards.originalTitle: Same Chart, Different Story: Bias in Vision-Language Chart Interpretation

keyPoints: 项目定位是让智能体记忆具备学习能力，而非单纯存储历史。
项目出现在 GitHub Trending Daily，反映近期社区关注度。
输入中不含实现细节、数据集或评测结果。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Long-term memory in agents is often seen as critical to coherence across multi-turn tasks; if memory can adapt from interaction feedback, it could change how agents retain and use information in sustained tasks. The project's trending status suggests this direction is drawing developer interest and warrants tracking its later public technical and experimental information.
cards.descriptionEn: The project positions itself as agent memory that learns and has appeared in GitHub Trending Daily, suggesting growing community attention to upgrading memory from static storage to an experience-adaptive component. For developers building multi-turn, long-running agents, it can serve as an entry point to explore or experiment with memory mechanisms.
cards.limitationsEn: The input only includes the project name, tagline source, publication time, and link, with no paper, code structure description, benchmarks, or comparison results. Its learning mechanism, scope, performance, and reproducibility cannot be confirmed, and this does not constitute a judgment on project quality or usability.
cards.whyItMatters: 智能体的长期记忆常被视为影响多轮任务连贯性的关键环节；若记忆能随交互反馈调整，可能改变智能体在持续任务中的信息保留与使用方式。该项目的热度说明这一方向正获得开发者关注，值得跟踪其后续公开的技术与实验信息。
cards.titleEn: Hindsight: An Open-Source Project for Learnable Agent Memory
cards.summaryEn: Hindsight is a project by vectorize-io on GitHub, described as 'Agent Memory That Learns,' pointing to memory that can learn rather than merely store history. Beyond the title and tagline, the input provides no architecture, algorithm, evaluation, or experimental results, so its concrete capabilities remain unknown.
cards.summary: Hindsight 是 vectorize-io 在 GitHub 上的项目，其简介为“Agent Memory That Learns”，核心指向让智能体记忆具备学习能力。除这一标题与简介外，输入未提供架构、算法、评测或实验结果，因此具体能力仍属未知。
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目名称、简介来源、发布时间和链接，没有论文、代码结构说明、基准测试或对比结果；无法确认其学习机制、适用范围、性能与可复现性，也不构成对项目质量或使用效果的判断。
cards.title: Hindsight：让智能体记忆可学习的开源项目
keyPointsEn: The project is positioned as agent memory that can learn, not just store history.
It appeared in GitHub Trending Daily, reflecting recent community attention.
The input contains no implementation details, datasets, or evaluation results.
cards.description: 该项目以“智能体记忆会学习”为定位，出现在 GitHub 日趋势中，说明社区正在关注将记忆从静态存储升级为可随经验调整的组件。对构建多轮、长期运行智能体的开发者，可作为了解或实验记忆机制方向的入口。

keyPoints: 审计覆盖30项交易相关原始研究，用编码证据矩阵评估执行假设与可复现性维度。
审计样本中，架构报告普遍比评估假设（如时点控制、成本与换手处理）更清晰。
一个10只股票示例仅作为方法 scaffold，说明显式摩擦与时机选择可显著压缩主动策略结果。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Without transparent execution timing, transaction costs, and turnover treatment, reported LLM trading performance is hard to compare, interpret economically, or reproduce, potentially overstating strategy viability. The audit offers a checklist for researchers and reviewers to assess execution realism.
cards.descriptionEn: A reproducibility audit of 30 LLM trading studies finds architecture reporting clearer than execution assumptions, calling for explicit reporting standards on execution realism and comparability.
cards.limitationsEn: This work is a targeted topical review and reproducibility audit, not a new backtest or empirical performance test; the 10-equity example is only a methodological scaffold and not performance evidence; the audit sample is limited to 30 trade-relevant primary studies and may not cover all LLM trading literature; the conclusions do not judge the profitability of any specific strategy.
cards.whyItMatters: 若执行时机、交易成本与换手处理等假设不透明，LLM交易系统的业绩报告难以横向比较、经济解释或复现，可能高估策略可行性。该审计为研究者与审稿人提供评估执行现实性的检查框架。
cards.titleEn: Execution Assumptions and Reproducibility Gaps in LLM-Based Trading Systems
cards.summaryEn: The authors conduct a coded audit of 30 trade-relevant primary studies, assessing point-in-time controls, split transparency, cost and turnover treatment, and other execution assumptions. Across the sample, architecture reporting is generally clearer than the evaluation assumptions, making trading results hard to interpret economically or reproduce. The authors argue that the next step for LLM trading research is clearer reporting standards for execution realism and reproducibility, not only better agent design.
cards.summary: 作者对30项交易相关原始研究进行编码审计，评估时点控制、拆分透明度、成本与换手处理等执行假设。审计样本显示，架构报告通常比评估假设更清晰，导致交易结果难以经济解释或复现。作者观点认为，LLM交易研究的下一步应优先建立执行现实性与可复现性的报告标准，而非仅改进智能体设计。
cards.limitations: 该工作为针对性主题综述与可复现性审计，而非新策略回测或实证检验；10只股票示例仅为方法 scaffold，不构成业绩证据；审计样本限于30项交易相关原始研究，可能未覆盖全部LLM交易文献；结论不代表对任何具体策略盈利能力的判断。
cards.title: LLM交易系统的执行假设与可复现性缺口
keyPointsEn: The audit covers 30 trade-relevant primary studies using a coded evidence matrix to assess execution assumptions and reproducibility dimensions.
Across the audited sample, architecture reporting is generally clearer than evaluation assumptions such as point-in-time controls, cost, and turnover treatment.
A 10-equity example serves only as a methodological scaffold, illustrating how explicit friction and timing choices can materially compress active-strategy results.
cards.description: 该文章对30项LLM交易研究进行可复现性审计，发现架构报告比执行假设更清晰，并提出需明确报告执行现实性与评估可比性。
cards.originalTitle: Beyond Agent Architecture: Execution Assumptions and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems

keyPoints: 定位为完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 替代方案
功能整合语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转写和有声书制作
声称支持 646 种语言
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the project delivers on its claimed local operation and multilingual capabilities, it could offer an open-source option for developers and content creators concerned about data privacy, offline use, or avoiding subscription-based cloud voice services.
cards.descriptionEn: VoiceStudio is an open-source project featured on GitHub Trending Daily, positioned as a fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs. It bundles voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation, and claims coverage of 646 languages. Its novelty lies in packaging these voice capabilities into a local open-source option that avoids reliance on cloud services.
cards.limitationsEn: The available information comes only from the GitHub Trending project description and contains no author list, technical details, performance benchmarks, independent testing, or known constraints. The extent of the 646-language support, voice cloning quality, local hardware requirements, license terms, whether any cloud components are required, and actual usability have not been verified. It should not be treated as a proven production-grade solution.
cards.whyItMatters: 若项目能实现其宣称的本地运行和多语言能力，可为关注数据隐私、离线使用或避免订阅云端语音服务的开发者与内容创作者提供一个开源选项。
cards.titleEn: Open-Source Local Voice Cloning Tool VoiceStudio Claims Support for 646 Languages and Video Dubbing
cards.summaryEn: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully local alternative to ElevenLabs, offering voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation. The project claims support for 646 languages. The above reflects factual statements from the source description, not independently verified performance or quality.

keyPoints: 标准GARCH与GJR-GARCH的短期参数稳定，但截距项随滚动窗口显著变化，Nyblom检验确认长期方差隐含值不稳定。
MSGARCH通过区制特定参数和滤波区制概率捕捉时变，获得最高对数似然和最低AIC，但BIC更支持GJR-GARCH。
一步向前回测显示各模型短期预测精度相近，MSGARCH的优势主要体现在分离高、低波动区制并对应重大市场事件。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For risk measurement and pricing of interest rate swaps and their options, the structural stability of volatility models directly affects long-run variance estimates and capital charges. If the long-run variance of standard GARCH drifts across windows, VaR or option pricing based on those parameters may be systematically biased; regime-switching models add complexity but provide regime-dependent volatility states linked to market conditions, which can aid stress testing and scenario analysis.
cards.descriptionEn: This study compares GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH(1,1), and a two-regime Markov-switching GARCH (MSGARCH) model for the conditional volatility of the USD 1Yx10Y forward swap rate using daily data from 2007 to 2023. The novelty lies in showing that the intercept of standard GARCH models varies markedly across rolling windows, causing instability in the implied long-run variance, while MSGARCH mitigates this through regime separation; market-implied measures (ATM swaption volatility an
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based solely on daily data for the USD 1Yx10Y forward swap rate from 2007 to 2023 and do not cover other currencies, tenors, or higher-frequency information. Model comparison relies on a single information criterion and one-step-ahead backtesting, without evaluating multi-step forecasts, extreme risk measures, or trading strategy performance. The MSGARCH specification assumes two regimes, without systematically testing more regimes or alternative transition forms. Market-implied measures are used only as auxiliary inputs, not in a joint estimation framework, so the impact of the volatility risk premium cannot be assessed. BIC favors the more parsimonious model, indicating that the out-of-sample gain from regime switching remains unclear.
cards.whyItMatters: 对利率互换及其期权进行风险计量和定价时，波动率模型的结构稳定性直接影响长期方差估计与资本计提。若标准GARCH的长期方差随窗口漂移，基于该参数的 VaR 或期权定价可能出现系统性偏差；机制转换模型虽增加复杂度，但能提供与市场状态挂钩的波动率区制判断，有助于压力测试与情景分析。
cards.titleEn: Modeling Interest Rate Swap Volatility: A Comparison of GARCH and Regime-Switching Approaches
cards.summaryEn: The study examines the conditional volatility dynamics of the USD 1Yx10Y forward swap rate using GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH(1,1), and a two-regime MSGARCH model on daily data from 2007 to 2023. Empirically, short-run parameters are stable in standard GARCH and GJR-GARCH, but the intercept varies markedly across rolling windows, with the Nyblom test confirming this instability; MSGARCH keeps regime-specific parameters stable, achieves the highest log-likelihood and lowest AIC, while BIC favors the more parsimonious GJR-GARCH. The authors argue that MSGARCH captures time variation through filtered regime probabilities and provides a clearer structural interpretation by isolating high- and low-volatility regimes aligned with major market events.
cards.summary: 研究检验美元1Yx10Y远期互换利率的条件波动率动态，使用GARCH(1,1)、GJR-GARCH(1,1)和两机制MSGARCH，样本为2007至2023年日度数据。事实层面，标准GARCH和GJR-GARCH的短期参数稳定，但截距项在不同滚动窗口中变化明显，Nyblom检验确认该不稳定性；MSGARCH的区制特定参数更稳定，且对数似然最高、AIC最低，而BIC更支持简约的GJR-GARCH。作者观点认为，MSGARCH通过过滤区制概率刻画时变，并能区分与重大市场事件对应的高、低波动区制，结构解释更清晰。
cards.limitations: 结论仅基于美元1Yx10Y远期互换利率2007至2023年的日度数据，未覆盖其他币种、期限或更高频信息。模型比较依赖单一信息准则和一步向前回测，未评估多步预测、极端风险度量或交易策略表现。MSGARCH的区制数量设定为两机制，未系统检验更多区制或区制转移形式。市场隐含指标仅作为辅助输入，未构建联合估计框架，因此无法判断波动率风险溢价的影响。BIC倾向于更简约模型，说明机制转换的样本外增益尚不明确。
cards.title: 利率互换波动率建模：GARCH与机制转换的比较
keyPointsEn: Short-run parameters of standard GARCH and GJR-GARCH are stable, but the intercept varies significantly across rolling windows, with the Nyblom test confirming instability in the implied long-run variance.
MSGARCH captures time variation through regime-specific parameters and filtered regime probabilities, achieving the highest log-likelihood and lowest AIC, though BIC favors GJR-GARCH.
One-step-ahead backtesting indicates comparable short-horizon accuracy across models; MSGARCH's advantage lies mainly in separating high- and low-volatility regimes aligned with major market events.
cards.description: 该研究基于2007至2023年美元远期互换利率日度数据，比较GARCH、GJR-GARCH与两机制MSGARCH对条件波动率的刻画能力。新意在于：标准GARCH的截距项在滚动窗口间显著变化，导致隐含长期方差不稳定，而MSGARCH通过区制分离缓解该问题；同时引入ATM互换期权波动率与SRVIX等市场隐含指标进行辅助验证。对量化风险管理和衍生品定价而言，提供了模型选择与结构解释的实证依据。
cards.originalTitle: Modeling interest rate swap volatility with GARCH processes

keyPoints: 基准要求智能体在预算内查看代码、选择测量并提交覆盖全部组件配置的响应面预测。
穷举CPU执行提供每个组件单独变更的参考效应，覆盖36个任务、30个数据源、8种工作流和1248条配置记录。
在8个新测量下，pair-effect ridge在22个数据源中的15个选出最优，高斯过程将同一批观测的效应恢复从0.632提升至0.698。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a reproducible quantitative standard for AI research agents' experimental understanding and suggests that exploiting program structure, such as code equivalences, may improve outcome prediction under limited budgets, with direct relevance to adaptive experimental design and numerical inference research.
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces WhatWorkedBench to evaluate AI research agents' ability to predict component-change effects under a limited experiment budget, scored by comparing submitted response surfaces with exhaustive reference effects. Its value is turning experimental understanding into a quantitative benchmark and showing that encoding program structure can improve predictions.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from the benchmark authors' specific tasks, data sources, and workflow settings; effect-recovery and configuration-selection results should not be generalized to general agent capability or real-world research performance. The benchmark relies on exhaustive CPU execution for references, and task scope, measurement budgets, and agent implementations bound the conclusions. The work does not report full statistical significance, cross-domain generalization, or deployment validation, nor does it address real experimental costs and risks.
cards.whyItMatters: 它为AI研究智能体的实验理解能力提供了可复现的量化标准，并暗示利用程序结构（如代码等价关系）可能改善有限预算下的结果预测，对自适应实验设计和数值推断研究有直接参考价值。
cards.titleEn: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the authors build WhatWorkedBench, where agents inspect code, select measurements, and submit a response surface, while exhaustive CPU execution supplies reference effects for changing each component; it covers 36 tasks, 30 data sources, 8 workflow types, and 1248 configuration records. Results: with eight new measurements, pair-effect ridge selects the optimum on 15 of 22 sources; fitting a Gaussian process to the same agent observations raises effect recovery from 0.632 to 0.698 in the original Flash cohort. Authors' view: encoding code equivalences further improves recovery, and the benchmark supports research on experimental agents, adaptive experimental design, numerical inference, and use of program structure.
cards.summary: 事实：作者构建 WhatWorkedBench，让智能体查看代码、选择测量并提交响应面，用穷举CPU执行得到每个组件单独变更的参考效应，覆盖36个任务、30个数据源、8种工作流和1248条配置记录。结果：在8个新测量下，pair-effect ridge在22个数据源中的15个选出最优配置；对同一批智能体观测改用高斯过程，可将原始Flash队列的效应恢复从0.632提升到0.698。作者观点：编码代码等价关系可进一步提升预测恢复，基准支持实验智能体、自适应实验设计、数值推断与程序结构利用等方向研究。
cards.limitations: 证据来自基准作者在特定任务、数据源和工作流上的实验设置，效应恢复与配置选择结果不应外推为通用智能体能力或实际科研表现。基准依赖穷举CPU执行提供参考，任务范围、测量预算和智能体实现方式均限定结论边界。文中未报告完整统计显著性、跨领域泛化或部署环境验证，也未涉及真实实验成本与风险。
cards.title: WhatWorkedBench：衡量AI智能体对实验变化的理解能力
keyPointsEn: The benchmark requires agents to inspect code, select measurements within a budget, and submit response surfaces predicting scores for all component configurations.
Exhaustive CPU execution provides reference effects for changing each component while holding others fixed, covering 36 tasks, 30 data sources, 8 workflow types, and 1248 configuration records.
With eight new measurements, pair-effect ridge selects the optimum on 15 of 22 sources, and a Gaussian process raises effect recovery from 0.632 to 0.698 on the same observations.
cards.description: 该工作提出 WhatWorkedBench，用于评估AI研究智能体在有限实验预算下预测组件变更效果的能力，核心指标是智能体提交的响应面预测与穷举参考效应的偏差。其价值在于将实验理解从定性讨论转为可量化的基准，并给出提示基于程序结构编码可改善预测。
cards.originalTitle: WhatWorkedBench: Benchmarking Experimental Understanding in AI Agents

keyPoints: 模型将做市商的最优执行刻画为连续控制与冲击控制的混合问题，并加入对残余 delta 与 vega 的惩罚项。
作者把交易所的返佣设计视为与做市策略相互嵌套的优化问题，提出三步返佣设计流程并允许嵌入特定流动性目标。
文中以数值结果支持所提方案的有效性，但未在摘要中给出具体参数、误差界或市场仿真细节。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework links a market maker's micro-level execution decisions with the exchange's rebate instrument, offering an analytical structure for understanding how liquidity incentives shape option market-making behavior. If the method holds, it could help exchanges explicitly incorporate liquidity targets into rebate setting rather than relying on empirical fee adjustments.
cards.descriptionEn: This paper models a market maker's continuous quoting and impulse-style taking controls in a local-stochastic volatility option market, and formulates exchange rebate design as a nested optimization; its novelty lies in combining market-making strategy and liquidity incentives in one framework, yielding a stepwise scheme for exchanges to set targeted rebates and improve liquidity.
cards.limitationsEn: The source abstract provides only an overview of the model framework and numerical validation, without specifying numerical settings, robustness checks, or out-of-sample performance. Conclusions depend on local-stochastic volatility modeling assumptions and the market maker's objective function form, and do not address real-market transaction costs, competing market makers, information asymmetry, or regulatory constraints. Whether the three-step rebate scheme can meet liquidity targets in a real exchange environment requires independent replication and empirical testing.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架把做市商的微观执行决策与交易所的返佣工具联系起来，为理解流动性激励如何影响期权做市行为提供了一个可分析的结构；若方法成立，可帮助交易所在设定返佣时把流动性目标显式纳入优化，而不是依赖经验性费率调整。
cards.titleEn: Liquidity Provision and Rebate Design in Option Markets: A Nested Optimization Model and Three-Step Scheme
cards.summaryEn: The authors build a nested optimization model for option market making and rebate design: a single market maker trades multiple European call options in a local-stochastic volatility market using continuous make and impulse take controls, maximizing net option portfolio value plus cumulative rebate revenue subject to penalties on residual delta and vega. On this basis, they show how an exchange can incentivize the market maker to improve liquidity by setting suitable rebates, and propose a three-step rebate design scheme flexible enough to accommodate specific liquidity targets. Numerical results are provided to validate the scheme's effectiveness; these modeling choices, solution methods, and numerical claims are the authors' technical assertions rather than neutral conclusions about real-market outcomes.
cards.summary: 作者建立了一个期权做市与返佣设计的嵌套优化模型：单一做市商在局部随机波动率市场中对多只欧式看涨期权同时进行连续报单与冲击式吃单，目标是在对残余 delta 与 vega 施加惩罚下，最大化期权组合净收益与累计返佣收入之和。在此基础上，作者提出交易所可通过设定合适返佣来激励做市商改善流动性，并给出可适配特定流动性目标的三步返佣设计流程；数值结果用于验证该流程的有效性。需要指出，模型设定、求解方法与数值验证属于作者的技术主张，而非对真实市场效果的中立结论。
cards.limitations: 原文摘要仅给出模型框架与数值验证的概述，未说明具体数值设置、稳健性检验范围及样本外表现；结论依赖于局部随机波动率市场的建模假设与做市商目标函数形式，未涉及真实市场交易成本、竞争性做市、信息不对称或监管约束。三步返佣方案能否在真实交易所环境中达到流动性目标，需要独立复现与实盘数据检验。
cards.title: 期权做市返佣设计：嵌套优化模型与三步方案
keyPointsEn: The model casts optimal market making as a mixed continuous and impulse control problem, with penalties on residual delta and vega.
The exchange's rebate design is treated as a nested optimization alongside the market-making strategy, and a three-step rebate scheme is proposed that can embed specific liquidity targets.
Numerical results support the scheme's effectiveness, but the abstract gives no specific parameters, error bounds, or market simulation details.
cards.description: 本文在局部随机波动率期权市场中刻画做市商的连续报单与冲击式吃单控制问题，并将交易所返佣设计建模为三层嵌套优化；其新意在于把做市策略与流动性激励放在同一框架内求解，为交易所设定针对性返佣以提升流动性提供了可操作的步骤化方案。
cards.originalTitle: Liquidity Provision and Rebate Design in Option Markets

keyPoints: 框架用递减CVaR约束在组合层面直接控制风险，目标收益由养老金设计输入外生决定。
每月从满足CVaR约束的配置集合中抽取配置，而非假设每期选最优组合，因此成功概率是可行配置上的平均而非最优情形。
智利案例显示风险开始下降的过渡年龄是最关键设计参数，缴费密度是硬约束。
提出两项评价指标：达到目标收益的概率和TDF存续期内累计承担的风险。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework shifts TDF design from age-based asset-class limits toward an explicit return objective and a quantifiable CVaR glidepath, enabling regulators or sponsors to assess the probability of meeting the target return and the cumulative risk taken under a given risk path, and to establish a testable link between pension design inputs and portfolio risk. For systems facing population aging and pension reform, it offers an analytical tool for evaluating how design and contribution constraints interact, though the case results depend on specific model assumptions and cannot be directly extrapolated to actual policy outcomes.
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a target-date fund design framework oriented around an explicit return objective and controlling portfolio risk through a declining CVaR constraint, applied as a proof of concept to Chile's 2025 pension reform using nine asset classes and a 40-year accumulation horizon.
cards.limitationsEn: This is an arXiv preprint and has not yet undergone peer review. The Chilean case is a self-contained proof of concept using nine asset classes and a 40-year accumulation horizon; its results depend on model assumptions, parameter choices, and the data period, and should not be read as predictions of actual Chilean pension outcomes or the performance of any specific TDF. The framework assumes monthly random draws from the set of CVaR-feasible allocations, a conservative evaluation that does not model actual manager decision-making or market frictions. Because the target return is exogenous, the framework cannot guarantee valid results if the inputs are inaccurate or unattainable. Specific numbers such as the contribution-density threshold hold only under the case's assumptions and are not generalizable.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将TDF设计从按年龄限制资产类别，转向以显式目标收益和可量化的CVaR路径为核心，使监管者或发起人能够评估给定风险路径下达到目标收益的概率以及累计承担的风险，并为养老金设计输入与组合风险之间建立可检验的联系。对面临人口老龄化与养老金改革的制度而言，它提供了一种评估设计与缴费约束相互作用的分析工具，但案例结果依赖于具体模型假设，不能直接外推为实际政策效果。
cards.titleEn: A Declining CVaR Glidepath Framework for Target-Date Fund Design with an Application to the Chilean Pension System
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a target-date fund (TDF) design framework in which a regulator or sponsor specifies a declining Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) glidepath, and the manager draws an allocation each month from the set of portfolios satisfying the CVaR constraint rather than assuming an optimal portfolio is chosen each period, yielding a conservative evaluation of success probabilities. The target return is exogenous, derived from pension design inputs such as retirement age, contribution rate, working years, life expectancy, and replacement-rate goals, which differs from conventional TDF design based on age-dependent asset-class limits. Using Chile's 2025 pension reform as a proof of concept with nine Chilean and global asset classes and a 40-year accumulation horizon, the authors report that the transition age at which risk begins to decline is the most consequential design parameter and that contribution density acts as a hard constraint, with portfolio design unable to compensate below a critical threshold. These specific numerical findings are illustrative results under the authors' model assumptions, not predictions of actual pension outcomes.
cards.summary: 作者提出一种目标日期基金（TDF）设计框架：由监管者或发起人给定递减的条件风险价值（CVaR）路径，组合管理者在满足CVaR约束的配置集合中每月抽取配置，而非假设每期选择最优组合，从而得到偏保守的成功概率评估。目标收益外生给定，来自退休年龄、缴费率、工作年限、预期寿命和替代率目标等养老金设计输入，这区别于按年龄设定资产类别限制的传统做法。作者以智利2025年养老金改革为概念验证，使用九类智利与全球资产和40年积累期，报告风险开始下降的过渡年龄是最关键的设计参数，缴费密度低于临界阈值时组合设计无法弥补结构性低缴费。上述具体数值结论属于作者基于其模型设定的示例性结果，并非对真实养老金结果的预测。
cards.limitations: 文献为arXiv预印本，需经同行评议。智利案例是作者自行设定的概念验证，使用九类资产和40年积累期，其结果依赖于模型假设、参数取值与数据区间，不能视为对智利养老金实际结果或任何特定TDF业绩的预测。框架假设每月从满足CVaR约束的配置集合中随机抽取，属于保守评估方式，未刻画管理者的实际决策行为与市场摩擦。目标收益由养老金设计输入外生给定，若输入不准确或不可实现，框架无法保证结果有效。缴费密度阈值等具体数值仅在该案例设定下成立，不具普遍性。
cards.title: 基于递减CVaR路径的目标日期基金设计框架及智利应用
keyPointsEn: The framework controls risk directly at the portfolio level via a declining CVaR constraint, with the target return determined exogenously from pension design inputs.

Each month an allocation is drawn from the set of portfolios satisfying the CVaR constraint rather than assuming an optimal portfolio is chosen, so success probabilities are averages over admissible allocations rather than best-case outcomes.
The Chilean case shows that the transition age at which risk starts to decline is the most consequential design parameter, and that contribution density acts as a hard constraint.
Two figures of merit are introduced: the probability of meeting the target return and the cumulative risk assumed over the life of the TDF.
cards.description: 提出以显式目标收益为导向、用递减CVaR约束控制组合风险的目标日期基金设计框架，并将其应用于智利2025年养老金改革，用九类资产和40年积累期做概念验证。

cards.titleEn: What 1 Nanosecond Means in HFT: Key Takeaways from the Algo Trading Conference 2026
cards.summaryEn: At the conference, Sameer Kumar (Co-founder & CTO, iRage) gave an intuitive scale for 1 nanosecond: a 1-metre fibre cable takes 5 nanoseconds to cross, and if 1 nanosecond were stretched to 1 second, a blink of an eye would last about 10 years. Stefan Jansen noted that with coding cheap, value shifts to domain expertise and asking research agents good questions, citing a model with a naive t-stat of 6.1 that drops to 2.0 once overlapping labels are corrected. Multiple speakers stressed that AI is an amplifier, not a source of judgment, and should be used as a tool rather than a crutch.
cards.summary: 会议中，iRage联合创始人Sameer Kumar给出1纳秒的直观尺度：1米光纤传输耗时5纳秒，若将1纳秒拉长至1秒，一次眨眼约相当于10年。Stefan Jansen指出编程成本下降后，价值转向领域专长与向研究代理提出好问题，并举例一个模型朴素t统计量为6.1，修正重叠标签后降至2.0。多位与会者强调AI是放大器而非判断力来源，应作为工具而非拐杖。
